protocol.hypothesis: The published direction of a scheduled Bank of Russia key-rate decision (hike, cut, hold) may predict 1H equity returns after the information is public. Test conventional and inverse mappings and explicit hold-day choices, without using the candle move to choose direction.
protocol.decision_snapshot: decisions.json: 23 scheduled key-rate decisions from 2024-02-16 through 2026-10-23, with official release URLs, published direction and rate; metadata or calendar time 13:30 Moscow; no contemporaneous consensus forecast
protocol.parameter_rationale: Four predeclared rate-to-position mappings and 1/3/6 post-entry completed-hour holds. The 23 event dates are the independent calendar units; cross-sectional stock rows are correlated.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and 1H candles, next-open filled. Flat cash is also the natural zero-return control for the sparse event trades; neither is exposure matched.
protocol.signal_rule: On each scheduled event, read the actual announced rate and the previous announced rate from decisions.json. Conventional: hike -> short, cut -> long, hold -> flat. Inverse: hike -> long, cut -> short, hold -> flat. Hold-long/hold-short use conventional directions for changes and respectively long/short on unchanged decisions. No candle direction or future rate enters this decision. The 13:00 bar straddles the 13:30 published release; wait for a complete 14:00-15:00 bar, signal at its close, enter at next 15:00 open, and exit after 1/3/6 completed bars at the next open. If required bars missing, skip the symbol-event. No data on ex-ante consensus: rate change is not interpreted as a surprise.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research only; compare rate-category outcomes across 23 independent dates, not apparent stock-event sample size. No auto paper promotion without strong monthly evidence, rate-source audit, Pine parity and full data review.
limitations: Press-release page timestamp is available for some releases; 13:30 is the official archive or planned time for the remainder, not independently measured delivery to a trader terminal
No historical consensus expectation series; realized rate change may have been priced before the event
Only 3 hikes, 10 cuts and 10 holds over 23 scheduled events; stocks on a date are correlated
Hourly bars cannot resolve the initial 13:30-14:00 reaction; deliberate later entry at 15:00

blockers: Все 12 заранее фиксированных правил торговли после решения ЦБ имеют отрицательную медианную среднемесячную доходность по 263 акциям после расходов: от -0.02% до -0.06%. Даже лучший по отдельным датам inverse_3 даёт лишь +0.0034% медианы счёта на 13 датах изменений ставки, при -0.02% медианы среднемесячной доходности. Очевидно слабую торговую гипотезу закрываем до paper.
